decisions.statement: The ring drawn is the ring the surplus tile draws rather than a ring of its own.
The color is read off the feed rather than worked out on the phone.
A cost carries no tier above and no fraction climbed.
No arc is drawn for such a cost.
The caption counts down to the rung the surplus is about to fall past.
Which moment that is comes off the feed rather than being worked out here.
The caption counts down as a bare timer rather than in spelled words.
Nothing is written after the count, so the tile reads as the count alone.

definition: Alan's tile for what the block he is in costs him each hour
